title: Add test for heal-failure Err(Io) retry idempotency in announce_store load
description: Found by robustness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml. The fix relies on a failed heal write (announce_store.rs:273) leaving (Some(state), None) on disk and the next load retrying the heal successfully, but no test covers this and FileStorage has no fault-injection seam (unlike MemStorage fail_after_writes at lichen-hal/src/storage.rs:443). The retry is byte-idempotent only because Schnorr48 signing is deterministic (schnorr.rs:3, determinism test at :637). Fix: add a fault-injection seam to FileStorage or simulate via a raw unwritable floor path, then assert first load returns Err(Io) with floor still absent and second load heals to Ok(Some(state)) with identical record bytes.
